title: Seeds of Wisdom from Sultan ul-Awliya
body:
Mawlana Shaykh Advises Guests from Different Countries
May Allah the Almighty forgive us for every wrong acting, and blessings on all of you. Try to be servants of
the Lord of Heavens, and you will be happy here and Hereafter. Al-Fatihah.
Pray to Allah (swt) and try to be His servants. We can't do anything, but we are trying to be good servants of
the Lord of Heavens, Allah Almighty. Al-Fatihah. Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna
Muhammadan `abduhu wa habeebuhu wa rasooluh (s). Allahuma thabitnaa `ala ‘l-Haqq bi jaahi man
anzalta `alayhi Surat al-Fatihah.

CHILDBIRTH/NEWBORNS
When your wife delivers your baby, you must slaughter two sheep; one for Shah Naqshband and the other for
all awliya that are looking to make the baby perfect. Daily, give one sadaqa for her and one sadaqa for the
baby; this is my advise don't worry.

HAJJ 1432
I have not given permission to say you may go. Every ne who goes may carry their own responsibility and
they should not go for too long. If anything happens, they must quickly come back by bus, plane, car or by
ships; they must move. Al-Fatihah.
The dunya is running to its final destination, therefore there are so many disturbances and problems, so keep
yourself in your homes as we don't like people to run through streets; it is not good. The Lord of Heavens is
never happy if you are asking something like that. Christians may go to churches or cathedrals, Muslims may
go to their mosques, and Jewish people may go to their synagogues; everyone must run to their Lord's house.
Streets are roads of Shaytan! They are no good and that is where troubles rise without coming down.

ANGER
To be angry quickly is the character of Pakistanis. When you awake for night prayers, after two rak`aats stand
up (face qiblah) and say, "Yaa Haleem" one-hundred times.

NEW SHAHADAH
Your name and face are honored; your ancestors must have been nobles from the time of Louis XIV, so you
are also a noble one. Say you believe: in the Lord of Heavens; in akhirah (the Afterlife); in all prophets sent
from Heavens--Adam (a) to the Last Prophet, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)--on Judgment Day and in Heaven
and Hell. All major religions accept this, but Christians and Jews do not believe in the Last Prophet, why?
This is our holy book, the Holy Qur’an. A pure, innocent man who reached 40 years, who had not been to
school and had no teachers, said, “This message is from Heavens and it came to me just as it came to Jesus
Christ, Moses, Abraham, Noah and all prophets.” But people are not coming to say this. When they gather
they will see it is based on one belief. Say with me now, “Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illa-Llah, wa ash-hadu anna

Sayyidina Muhammadan `abduhu wa habeebuhu wa rasooluh.” (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
He is the Last Prophet. We are believing in all prophets and in all holy books; the Bible, the Psalms and the
Holy Qur’an, and we surrender to the holy commands of Heavens: this is to be Muslim. We have been
ordered to do good things and we are prohibited from bad things. Your name will be Abraham, “Ibraheem.”
Fatihah.
Thank you for your visit, bienvenue! Come again. If you need something I shall give it to you, as you are a
good one. (Mawlana Shaykh gives him currency). This is not real money, but gold is.
